{{Nickname}}
'''Rust Rats''' was a nickname for the poor, downtrodden populace at the bottom of society on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]]. These people, mainly kids, had been subjugated for hundreds of years by various companies, including [[Torel Vorne]]'s [[Reuss Corporation]]. Due to environment problems caused by these corporations, the average lifespan of Reussi citizens was no more than forty years. Between [[5 ABY/Legends|5]] and [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], a [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] operation involving [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]] [[Lobar Aybock]] and [[Mygo Skinto]], posing as a Rust Rat, led to the suspension of the corporation's operations and the betterment of life for the Rust Rats.
